messages.text: Heads up: laptop refresh batch 2 starts this week. Engineering is up next, so expect the new M-series boxes to show up at your desks by Thursday. Please back up local dotfiles and any scratch work before you hand yours in.
Do we get to keep the old one for a few days after migrating? Last time I discovered a stray SSH config two days after wipe.
Yes, 5 business days overlap. After that they go to the imaging queue and get wiped. Don't count on it being around longer than that.
Quick question: are the new laptops enrolled in AuthSSO automatically or do we need to re-register our hardware keys? I'd rather not get locked out mid-deploy.
You need to re-register. Provisioning sets up the device cert, but the hardware key has to be re-bound in AuthSSO manually. Do it while the old laptop is still logged in so you have a fallback.
Perfect, thanks Priya. I'll do it first thing when mine arrives.
I have a few local Postgres dumps pulled from PositionStore snapshots for a backfill test. Is it ok to just copy those to the new machine, or should they go through DocVault or somewhere approved?

Don't copy them over directly. Delete the local dumps if you can, and re-pull a masked snapshot on the new box. Anything unmasked shouldn't sit on a laptop anyway, so this is a good chance to clean up.
Fair enough. They're masked mostly, but I'll just regenerate. Wiping now.
Also, are we still on the 32GB config for engineering? My local integration test suite chokes at 16GB.
Yes, 32GB for all of us in Technology. I'm out of here October 9 so mine goes to whoever picks up my queue, just FYI for the asset tracker, Barbara.
